scope: Offscreen sampling/render-pipeline probe of wrapper-decoded BC1/BC3 (UNORM and sRGB) and RGBA8 control textures: upload through the pinned wrapper, sample through a real graphics pipeline (fullscreen triangle, nearest sampler, RGBA8 render target), read back and compare against an independently derived expected render image. Software Vulkan emulator only; no phone/Adreno result claimed.

fixture.render_usage: render LIBRARY FORMAT INPUT OUTPUT W H RW RH VERT_SPV FRAG_SPV; FORMAT bc1|bc3|bc1_srgb|bc3_srgb|rgba8

shaders.note: GLSL sources are committed; the SPIR-V hashes are the binary blobs used by the salvaged run. The exact glslang invocation was not captured with the run; any glslangValidator -V from the recorded toolchain family reproduces equivalent modules (recompile and compare the SPIR-V hash before claiming bit-identical shaders).

probe_binary.build: NDK r27d aarch64-linux-android34-clang, -std=c11 -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -D_GNU_SOURCE, -ldl, 16 KB max/common page-size flags (recorded command printed by tools/tests/vulkan-wrapper-render.py --print-runbook)

checker.functions: independently re-derives expected render images from the saved decoded textures (nearest upscale; sRGB encoded/linear conventions with double precision ties-to-even), verifies the recorded expected files, then compares every readback; --print-runbook prints device reproduction commands

run.emulator: AVD Vapor_UI_API36 (Android 16/API 36, 4 KB pages), serial emulator-5556, llvmpipe (LLVM 21.1.4, 128 bits), driver llvmpipe/Mesa 26.0.0-devel; run 2026-10-22 01:44-01:46 local
run.derivation_verified: The recorded expected images match an independent re-derivation exactly: unorm and srgb-encoded = nearest upscale of the saved decoded texture; srgb-linear = nearest upscale of the sRGB->linear (IEC 61966-2-1, double precision, ties-to-even) transform (max delta 0 for both BC1 and BC3).

results.checker: python3 tools/tests/vulkan-wrapper-render.py --dir <evidence> => 32 pass / 0 fail / 0 skipped (33 readbacks scanned); 16/32 byte-exact

groups.group: Wrapper compute and compute-view, BC1/BC3 UNORM
groups.result: byte-exact for BC1 and BC3 (candidate and baseline)
BC1 byte-exact; BC3 776/16384 bytes differ by max 1 LSB (bcdec host decoder vs independent reference rounding)
within 1 LSB of the sRGB-linearised expected image (1,288 and 2,964 differing bytes, max delta 1)
groups.meaning: the sampling path renders linearised values, consistent with the emulated R8G8B8A8_UNORM image having no hardware sRGB decode

groups.result: matches the encoded convention (0/776 differing bytes) but not the linearised one (6,876/12,664 bytes, max delta 73)
groups.meaning: confirms the known compute-vs-host sRGB storage split at sampling time; the item is fixed experimentally by tools/vulkan-wrapper/srgb-storage.patch (see its receipt)

groups.result: matches the correct expected image within 3 LSB (BC1 1 LSB, BC3 2 LSB, sRGB 3 LSB; RGBA8 exact)
groups.meaning: expected inter-decoder rounding, not a wrapper path

results.conclusion: The wrapper-decoded textures survive a real sampled-rendering pipeline and produce the expected rendered images on the emulator, including sRGB sampling semantics; the only substantive deviation is the known host-CPU sRGB encode/linearise split, which is separately patched.

confirmed: Graphics pipeline (graphicsPipeline, render pass, framebuffer, sampler, descriptor set, draw, readback) works with the wrapper on llvmpipe
UNORM BC1/BC3 wrapper compute/compute-view rendering is byte-exact against the independent expected image
sRGB compute paths render the linearised convention within 1 LSB
The host-CPU sRGB path renders the encoded convention and differs from the linearised expectation by up to 73 LSB (known defect)
RGBA8 controls are byte-exact on all targets
